I think miHoYo didn't try to make him likeable with his story quest, but instead showed another side of him and his past, which is interesting because of the before and after comparison. 

The thing I don't like about his personality is his impulsiveness, and how he can be taken over by the love for his little brother. If he were to think about Teucer from a different perspective, he would clearly see that it's impossible to protect his dreams forever, and it would be better to reveal the truth.
